title: Probiotic cuts risk of respiratory infections in formula-fed babies | New Scientist
description: Babies who are formula fed are more prone to infections, but the addition of a probiotic supplement containing sugars from breast milk slashed the risk of such infants catching respiratory viruses
author: Carissa Wong

title: Neanderthal skeleton found with horrific injuries | New Scientist
description: A 75,000-year-old skeleton offers a glimpse into the violent world in which Neanderthals lived, but also offers hints that they cared for one another
author: James Woodford

title: A quarter of male soldiers in the US could have low testosterone | New Scientist
description: Newly introduced testosterone screening in the US Army could find more than 100,000 male soldiers with low testosterone
author: Alice Klein

title: Russia and China are using AI to stage relentless cyberattacks against the UK | New Scientist
description: AI is increasing the speed of attacks against infrastructure in the UK but also being used to help defend against it
author: Matthew Sparkes

title: Ancient shipwreck discovered off Turkey claimed to be world's oldest | New Scientist
description: A ship that sank in the Early Bronze Age was probably carrying jars of olive oil and may have been on its way to the ancient city of Troy when it sank
author: Jo Marchant

title: We can rescue the AMOC after its collapse – but it won’t be easy | New Scientist
description: An AMOC weakened by climate change can be revived by cooling global temperatures, but we don't have the technology to remove huge quantities of CO2 and drive that cooling
author: Madeleine Cuff
